mapper.select: SELECT id, product_name AS productName, product_type AS productType, period_months AS periodMonths, base_rate AS baseRate, max_rate AS maxRate, min_amount AS minAmount, max_amount AS maxAmount FROM deposit_products WHERE is_active = TRUE ORDER BY max_rate DESC, base_rate DESC

SELECT id, product_name AS productName, product_type AS productType, period_months AS periodMonths, base_rate AS baseRate, max_rate AS maxRate, min_amount AS minAmount, max_amount AS maxAmount FROM deposit_products WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT account_name AS accountName, account_type AS accountType, interest_rate AS interestRate, start_date AS startDate, maturity_date AS maturityDate FROM linked_bank_accounts WHERE id = #{accountId} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.update: UPDATE linked_bank_accounts SET balance = balance + CASE WHEN account_type = 'SAVINGS' THEN ROUND(balance * interest_rate * (GREATEST(COALESCE(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MONTH, start_date, maturity_date), 12), 1) + 1) / 24) ELSE ROUND(balance * interest_rate * GREATEST(COALESCE(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MONTH, start_date, maturity_date), 12), 1) / 12) END, interest_credited_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{accountId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND account_type IN ('DEPOSIT', 'SAVINGS') AND interest_rate IS NOT NULL AND maturity_date IS NOT NULL AND interest_credited_at IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO maturity_deposit_rollovers (user_id, linked_bank_account_id, maturity_date, product_name, product_type, amount, base_rate, max_rate, period_months) VALUES (#{userId}, #{linkedBankAccountId}, #{maturityDate}, #{productName}, #{productType}, #{amount}, #{baseRate}, #{maxRate}, #{periodMonths})
mapper.select: SELECT id, linked_bank_account_id AS linkedBankAccountId, maturity_date AS maturityDate, product_name AS productName, product_type AS productType, amount, base_rate AS baseRate, max_rate AS maxRate, period_months AS periodMonths, status, created_at AS createdAt FROM maturity_deposit_rollovers WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY id DESC

SELECT id, user_id AS userId, linked_bank_account_id AS linkedBankAccountId, amount FROM maturity_deposit_rollovers WHERE product_type = 'CMA' AND status = 'RESERVED' AND maturity_date IS NOT NULL AND maturity_date <= #{date} ORDER BY id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE maturity_deposit_rollovers SET status = #{status}, executed_at = CASE WHEN #{status} = 'EXECUTED' THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE executed_at END WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'RESERVED'
